QTA Packages

apt and yum repository of the QTA agent. Latest version: 0.99.4.

Signing key: qta-packages.asc, fingerprint D55F558CDB82358FB5B3C89152C5DE387C4DC951.

Debian, Ubuntu

curl -fsSL https://qta-company.github.io/packages-test/debian/public.key | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/qta-archive-keyring.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/qta-archive-keyring.gpg] https://qta-company.github.io/packages-test/debian stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/qta.list
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install qta qta-ui

Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma

sudo curl -fsSL -o /etc/yum.repos.d/qta.repo https://qta-company.github.io/packages-test/yum/qta.repo
sudo dnf install qta qta-ui

Install script

Adds this repository and installs the agent, plus the desktop app on a desktop session.

curl -fsSL https://github.com/qta-company/qta-agent/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
